text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Open-source and transparent security model.",
    "Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans.",
    "Strong encryption and robust security features.",
    "Cross-platform compatibility (desktop, mobile, browser extensions).",
    "Option for self-hosting for advanced users and organizations.",
    "Efficient and flexible item creation with diverse types."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Mobile app experience can sometimes be less intuitive or smooth.",
    "Steeper learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup.",
    "Customer support, while responsive, might not be as extensive as enterprise-focused solutions.",
    "Occasional minor issues with autofill or browser extension integration.",
    "Organization features can initially feel separated and have free-tier limitations.",
    "Lack of some niche integrations or advanced reporting features found in enterprise tools."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "pro 6: 'Reliable password syncing across devices.' replaced with 'Efficient and flexible item creation with diverse types.' justified by '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' and '[benefit] A login or secure note saves with only the Item name filled (username and password optional), so the CRM entry and the server-access note were each created in about three actions.'",
    "con 1: 'User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to competitors.' replaced with 'Organization features can initially feel separated and have free-tier limitations.' justified by '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.', '[friction] The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.', and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.'"
  ]
}

pros: Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans.
Strong encryption and robust security features.
Option for self-hosting for advanced users and organizations.
Efficient and flexible item creation with diverse types.
cons: Mobile app experience can sometimes be less intuitive or smooth.
Steeper learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup.
Customer support, while responsive, might not be as extensive as enterprise-focused solutions.
Occasional minor issues with autofill or browser extension integration.
Organization features can initially feel separated and have free-tier limitations.
Lack of some niche integrations or advanced reporting features found in enterprise tools.
changed: pro 6: 'Reliable password syncing across devices.' replaced with 'Efficient and flexible item creation with diverse types.' justified by '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' and '[benefit] A login or secure note saves with only the Item name filled (username and password optional), so the CRM entry and the server-access note were each created in about three actions.'

con 1: 'User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to competitors.' replaced with 'Organization features can initially feel separated and have free-tier limitations.' justified by '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.', '[friction] The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.', and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.'
